row: 中央七彩噴水池位於文化路、中山路、公明路、光華路交會處，中山路直通嘉義車站；每年九月底、十月初可見夕陽對準朝西街道落下的「懸日」。

airspace.zh: 嘉義市區鄰近機場，空域請以民航局「遙控無人機管理資訊系統」查詢；本片為電腦擬真畫面，非實地空拍。
airspace.en: Central Chiayi is close to an airport: check the airspace with the CAA drone system. This film is simulated, not real drone footage.

fountain.note: roundabout of Wenhua, Zhongshan, Gongming and Guanghua roads

road.note: the road from the fountain to the station

wenhua.note: night market street north of the fountain

east.note: toward the foothills of the Alishan range (approximate)

title.en: Chiayi: the hanging sun of Zhongshan Road

tagline.zh-Hant: 十月初的夕陽，對準噴水圓環前的中山路落下
tagline.en: In early October the setting sun lines up with Zhongshan Road

zh: 嘉義市中心的中央噴水池，又叫噴水圓環。
文化路、中山路、公明路、光華路在這裡交會。
en: In the heart of Chiayi sits the Central Fountain, also called the Fountain Roundabout.
Wenhua, Zhongshan, Gongming and Guanghua roads all meet here.

zh: 圓環上是投手雕像〈KANO1931〉，紀念嘉農投手吳明捷。
雕像由雕塑家蒲浩明製作；本片不重現雕像造型。
en: On the roundabout stands "KANO1931", a statue of Kano pitcher Wu Ming-chieh.
It is the work of sculptor Pu Hao-ming; this film does not reproduce it.

zh: 日治時期的市區改正，拉出直通嘉義車站的中山路。
1913 年嘉義水道完工，圓環有了噴水池。
en: Japanese-era town planning laid out Zhongshan Road, straight to Chiayi Station.
When the Chiayi waterworks opened in 1913, the roundabout got its fountain.

zh: 1970 年，許世賢市長把它改建成七彩噴水池。
她是台灣第一位女市長。
en: In 1970 Mayor Hsu Shih-hsien rebuilt it as the Seven-Colour Fountain.
She was Taiwan's first woman mayor.

zh: 這裡是文化路夜市的中心。
地方選舉的「選前之夜」，傳統上也在這裡。
en: It is the heart of the Wenhua Road night market.
By tradition, the rallies on the eve of local elections are held here too.

zh: 午後的光，斜斜照進中山路兩旁的街屋。
市府提醒，看夕陽請站在騎樓或天橋上，不要佔用車道。
en: Late light slants into the shopfronts along Zhongshan Road.
The city asks sunset watchers to stay under the arcades or on footbridges, off the road.

zh: 每年九月底到十月初，夕陽會對準朝西的街道落下。
中山路與民族路，都看得到這樣的「懸日」。
en: Each year around the turn of September and October, the sun sets in line with west-facing streets.
Zhongshan and Minzu roads both get this "hanging sun".

zh: 太陽掛在中山路的盡頭，整條街被染成金色。
依當天的日照計算，這一刻太陽正對著中山路。
en: The sun hangs at the end of Zhongshan Road and the whole street turns gold.
By that day's sun position, at this moment it lines up with the road.

zh: 太陽沉到嘉義車站後方的屋頂線。
車站在 1900 年完工，也是阿里山林業鐵路的起點。
en: The sun sinks behind the rooftops beyond Chiayi Station.
The station opened in 1900 and is where the Alishan Forest Railway begins.

zh: 圓環所在的位置，清代曾是嘉義城西北角的砲台。
一座城的中心，三百年來沒有離開這個路口。
en: In the Qing era, the city wall's north-west gun battery stood where the fountain is now.
For three centuries the heart of the city has stayed at this crossing.

zh: 東方的阿里山山脈，還留著一抹粉紅。
嘉義是上阿里山的門戶。
en: To the east, the Alishan range keeps a touch of pink.
Chiayi is the gateway to Alishan.

zh: 本片為擬真畫面：街道與建築取自地圖資料，
雕像沒有重現，日照依當天計算。
en: Simulated: streets and buildings come from map data,
the statue is not reproduced, and the light follows that day's sun.
